runtimeL3.evidence: All eight R6 capabilities observed on the matching device. Pixels: real Skia first frame through the egl-direct presenter (MoUIHarmony 'egl present ok=1 swap=1'), plus live resize across two distinct extents with content reflow and no stale-pixel ghosting once the EGL surface is recreated. Input: pointer presses increment the Showcase probe action count; keyboard text arrives through XComponent key events (the probe field changed from 'mobile-service-probe' to 'mobile-abc-probe'); mouse-wheel scrolling reaches the runtime as MouseWheel through the axis UI-input callback (content scrolled to reveal the probe image); Backspace/Delete arrive as named keys (two Backspace presses rewrote 'mobile-serviceab-probe' back to 'mobile-service-probe'); Ctrl+A resolves as a shortcut chord with the measured modifier mask (bit0=Ctrl) instead of inserting 'A'. IME: the same keyboard channel feeds Ime(Commit(...)), and pasteboard text is decoded to codepoints into it. Clipboard write: 'clipboard selftest wrote value=1' through OH_Pasteboard_SetData. Clipboard read: through the ArkTS PasteButton security control, 'clipboard read value=23' then 'clipboard granted read forwarded value=23' -- the platform permission (ohos.permission.READ_PASTEBOARD, system_basic + user_grant) makes a direct OH_Pasteboard_GetData call return ERR_PERMISSION_ERROR (201), so the security-control route is the supported one and is wired end to end. Accessibility: 'accessibility provider registered ok value=1' and 'accessibility published nodes value=87' through OH_NativeXComponent_GetNativeAccessibilityProvider + OH_ArkUI_AccessibilityProviderRegisterCallback, backed by the runtime semantics snapshot. Surface detach/recreate: 'surface destroyed width=2090 height=1324' on window close followed by a fresh process 'surface created width=2090 height=1324'. Async image: 'images ... ready=1x1' reporting the ImageLoading -> ImageReady transition from the renderer image diagnostics.
